findings.finding: Conflicting ADR count between parent AC4 and child S4. Parent AC4 says 'Each of the nine runbook-shaped ADRs'; child 6acd is titled/scoped to TEN ADRs (0012, 0031, 0048, 0059, 0079, 0085, 0105, 0109, 0112, 0113) and its AC1 verifies all ten. findings.suggested_fix: Update the parent Context and AC4 to say 'ten' ADRs, matching 6acd's enumerated ten files.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a `make verify` exit-0 acceptance criterion to children 2a3d, c159, 8257, and 6acd (or state explicitly that AC6 is validated once at epic close rather than per-story).
evidence: Parent AC: '`make verify` exits 0 after each story.'
28d0 AC: '`make verify` exits 0.' — the only child AC naming make verify.
2a3d/c159/8257/6acd ACs list only narrow gate commands; none asserts `make verify` green.
Passing check_docs_index / check_adr_numbers / a pytest subset does not establish that the full `make verify` (lint + full suite) is green after that story.
findings.finding: Parent AC6 ('make verify exits 0 after each story') is only delivered by one of the five children. Child 28d0 (S5) is the sole child whose acceptance criteria assert `make verify` exits 0; S1 (2a3d), S2 (c159), S3 (8257) and S4 (6acd) each assert only their targeted gate commands (check_docs_index, check_adr_numbers, gen_adr_index, pytest subsets), which are a precursor subset of `make verify`, not the same observable outcome.
scenarios: S2 lands, its ADR gates pass, but a lint rule or an unrelated test in the full `make verify` fails — the parent's per-story make-verify criterion is unmet yet the child's ACs are all green, so the completion verifier for the parent cannot be satisfied story-by-story.
findings.suggested_fix: Append a '`make verify` exits 0' AC to each of S1, S2, S3, S4, matching the parent's 'after each story' wording and S5's existing AC.

evidence: 5 criterion line(s) bundle multiple deliverables with 'and' (split so each is independently verifiable).
